In a world where conformity is normalised and individuality shunned, those that enjoy life’s truest
flavours start by living their authentic selves.
Tusker Cider exists to embody freedom and everything that comes with it. It is the golden, crisp,
great tasting and refreshing cider that ignites your yearning to be who you really are.
In FY2023/24, the aim is to accelerate cider performance to credibly drive LPA-24 recruitment
and be Kenya’s go-to accessible, refreshing alternative to a classic lager, RTD, wine and flavoured
drink, we creatively engaged our consumers in the on-trade, off-trade, and in third spaces through
Garden of Eden Executions, that were focused on driving trial through sampling and converting this
to purchase.
